info.title: Simple Analytics Universal API
info.description: Simple Analytics provides privacy-friendly website analytics APIs for aggregated stats, raw data exports, and account website administration.

post.description: Creates a new website in Simple Analytics.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the new website.

public.description: Whether the website should be public.

label.description: Optional label shown on the websites overview page.

error.description: Provider error message when website creation fails.

ok.description: Whether the website creation request was accepted.

success.description: Whether the website creation request succeeded.

get.description: Exports raw data points from Simple Analytics in JSON.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Website hostname to export data for, for example `simpleanalytics.com`.

schema.description: Website hostname to export data for, for example `simpleanalytics.com`.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH` format.

schema.description: Start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH` format.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End date in `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH` format.

schema.description: End date in `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH` format.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated raw data fields to return, such as `added_iso,path`.

schema.description: Comma-separated raw data fields to return, such as `added_iso,path`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Export data type, for example `pageviews`.

schema.description: Export data type, for example `pageviews`.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA time zone such as `Europe/Amsterdam`.

schema.description: IANA time zone such as `Europe/Amsterdam`.

parameters.name: robots
parameters.description: Whether to include robot traffic in the export.

schema.description: Whether to include robot traffic in the export.

meta.description: Export metadata including record count and generation timestamps.

get.description: Retrieves filtered stats from Simple Analytics.

parameters.description: Website hostname to query.

schema.description: Website hostname to query.

schema.description: Timezone like Europe/Amsterdam or UTC.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Comma-separated event names or * to return all events.

schema.description: Comma-separated event names or * to return all events.

schema.description: Histogram interval: hour, day, week, month, or year.
